tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind the tiles, and the fill under the cover and the tab bar. Depth is tile on ground, never a shadow. Text on it: ink, ink-2, ink-3.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Fill of every tile and event row. Text on it: ink, ink-2, ink-3. Also the halo and gap colour for marks drawn on a tile.

tokens.name: now-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of the one tinted tile, the current reading (the now tile), and the rain track and ribbon's ground. Text on it: ink and ink-on-now. Hatching and strong lines on it draw in ink-3.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, values, the pressed control's fill and the 2px focus ring. Text on ground, tile and now-surface. A pressed control is an ink fill with ground text.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Standfirsts, labels, in-chart labels and unpressed tab text. Text on ground, tile and now-surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Kickers, axis ticks, source lines and folded notes. Text on ground, tile and now-surface. Hatching and strong lines on the now tile draw in this colour.

tokens.name: ink-on-now
tokens.usage: Secondary text on now-surface only, the one place ink-2 is not used.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Dividers and horizontal gridlines only. Decorative, so it sits under 3:1 on purpose; never carries meaning. The track under the event size bar.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Every border or line a reader must see: control borders, chart baselines, dashed not-yet outlines, chip borders, chevron rings. 3:1 or better on ground and tile; on now-surface use ink-3 instead.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: The 135 degree gap hatch stripes on tile and ground. On the now tile the hatch is drawn in ink-3 because this falls under 3:1 there.

tokens.name: now
tokens.usage: Now Orange: the now rule, now dot and its label, the dot over today's bar, the current month and hour outline, the latest chip and the leading tile's dot. Marks the subject of the finding and nothing else. Text on ground, tile and now-surface; never touches a data fill.

tokens.name: median
tokens.usage: The dashed median over a usual band, in both themes. 3:1 against rain-band, temp-band and sun-band.

tokens.name: on-ramp-pale
tokens.usage: Text in a ramp cell when the cell is dark enough. White in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ramp-deep
tokens.usage: Text in a ramp cell when the cell is light. The ground-dark ink in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The colour of whatever a mark sits on. Aliases ground; a tile sets it to tile and the now tile to now-surface. Halos, the hatch ground and the ring round a now mark use it. Override it on the element that changes the surface.

tokens.name: rain-line
tokens.usage: The bold now-curve of a storm or season (3.5px), the water-year line for this year. 3:1 on tile and across rain-band.

tokens.name: rain-bar
tokens.usage: Daily rain bars, the event size bar, the live dot in the header. 3:1 on tile, ground and the rule track.

tokens.name: rain-band
tokens.usage: The usual band: the middle half of the comparison set. A pale fill edged by rain-band-edge in light; in dark the fill itself passes 3:1.

tokens.name: rain-band-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px edge that makes the rain band pass 3:1 on tile in light mode. Equals the fill in dark.

tokens.name: rain-0
tokens.usage: Almanac and rain-by-hour ramp, step 0 (least rain). Light mode ramps pale to deep; dark mode ramps deep to light, so more rain is lighter. 3:1 on tile and ground.

tokens.name: rain-1
tokens.usage: Rain ramp, step 1. Cell text uses on-rain-1.

tokens.name: rain-2
tokens.usage: Rain ramp, step 2. Cell text uses on-rain-2.

tokens.name: rain-3
tokens.usage: Rain ramp, step 3. Cell text uses on-rain-3.

tokens.name: rain-4
tokens.usage: Rain ramp, step 4 (most rain). Cell text uses on-rain-4.

tokens.name: temp-band
tokens.usage: The usual-range band behind each day's bar for that date. Pale in light mode, a mid slate in dark.

tokens.name: temp-band-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the temperature band, 3:1 on tile. Equals the fill in dark (3.07 on tile, one of the tightest pairs).

tokens.name: temp-cool
tokens.usage: Ten-day bar when the high stayed under usual; the cold bold line. 3:1 on temp-band.

tokens.name: temp-mild
tokens.usage: Ten-day bar when the high was level with usual. 3:1 on temp-band.

tokens.name: temp-warm
tokens.usage: Ten-day bar when the high ran over usual; the warm bold line. 3:1 on temp-band (3.16 in dark).

tokens.name: temp-iqr
tokens.usage: The 12px middle-half bar in the periods chart. 3:1 on tile.

tokens.name: sun-line
tokens.usage: The solar trace, a bold line. 3:1 on tile and across sun-band.

tokens.name: sun-bar
tokens.usage: Daily and quarter-hour solar bars. 3:1 on tile.

tokens.name: sun-band
tokens.usage: The solar usual band. Pale gold edged by sun-band-edge in light mode; the fill itself in dark.

tokens.name: sun-band-edge
tokens.usage: Edge that makes the sun band pass 3:1 on tile in light mode. Equals the fill in dark.

tokens.name: sun-0
tokens.usage: Solar almanac ramp, step 0 (dimmest). Runs dim to bright with the sun in both themes; the brightest day is the brightest cell. 3:1 on tile.

tokens.name: sun-1
tokens.usage: Solar ramp, step 1. Cell text uses on-sun-1.

tokens.name: sun-2
tokens.usage: Solar ramp, step 2. Light mode: 2.87:1 against tile, a named exception accepted 2026-11-04; the cell value, not the colour, carries the number.

tokens.name: sun-3
tokens.usage: Solar ramp, step 3. Light mode: 1.88:1 against tile, a named exception accepted 2026-11-04.

tokens.name: sun-4
tokens.usage: Solar ramp, step 4 (brightest). Light mode: 1.53:1 against tile, a named exception accepted 2026-11-04.

tokens.name: ribbon-night
tokens.usage: Night slots of the 48-hour ribbon. 3:1 against ribbon-day.

tokens.name: ribbon-day
tokens.usage: Day slots of the 48-hour ribbon.

tokens.name: ribbon-rain
tokens.usage: The ribbon's rain track bars: one colour, four steps told apart by bar height, never overprinted on the band. 3:1 on now-surface.

tokens.name: ribbon-edge
tokens.usage: The ribbon's outline, 3:1 on now-surface in light mode. Equals ribbon-day in dark, where the band passes by its fill.

tokens.name: on-rain-0
tokens.usage: Text colour inside rain ramp cell 0: whichever of on-ramp-pale and on-ramp-deep passes 4.5:1 there in this theme.

tokens.name: on-rain-1
tokens.usage: Text colour inside rain ramp cell 1: whichever of on-ramp-pale and on-ramp-deep passes 4.5:1 there in this theme.

tokens.name: on-rain-2
tokens.usage: Text colour inside rain ramp cell 2: whichever of on-ramp-pale and on-ramp-deep passes 4.5:1 there in this theme.

tokens.name: on-rain-3
tokens.usage: Text colour inside rain ramp cell 3: whichever of on-ramp-pale and on-ramp-deep passes 4.5:1 there in this theme.

tokens.name: on-rain-4
tokens.usage: Text colour inside rain ramp cell 4: whichever of on-ramp-pale and on-ramp-deep passes 4.5:1 there in this theme.

tokens.name: on-sun-0
tokens.usage: Text colour inside sun ramp cell 0: whichever of on-ramp-pale and on-ramp-deep passes 4.5:1 there in this theme.

tokens.name: on-sun-1
tokens.usage: Text colour inside sun ramp cell 1: whichever of on-ramp-pale and on-ramp-deep passes 4.5:1 there in this theme.

tokens.name: on-sun-2
tokens.usage: Text colour inside sun ramp cell 2: whichever of on-ramp-pale and on-ramp-deep passes 4.5:1 there in this theme.

tokens.name: on-sun-3
tokens.usage: Text colour inside sun ramp cell 3: whichever of on-ramp-pale and on-ramp-deep passes 4.5:1 there in this theme.

tokens.name: on-sun-4
tokens.usage: Text colour inside sun ramp cell 4: whichever of on-ramp-pale and on-ramp-deep passes 4.5:1 there in this theme.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The current temperature only. Desktop size; the shipped value is clamp(5.25rem, 22vw, 7.5rem). Tabular digits.

styles.name: display-phone
styles.usage: Floor of the display clamp, on a phone. Tabular digits.

styles.name: fact
styles.usage: The one large value on a quick-fact tile (desktop). Tabular digits.

styles.name: fact-phone
styles.usage: Fact on a phone. Tabular digits.

styles.name: finding-lead
styles.usage: The leading tile's finding and each tab's top finding (desktop), max 52ch.
styles.sample: It has rained for 3 hours, and 0.42 in has fallen.

styles.name: finding
styles.usage: A tile's finding and a closed finding row's label (desktop), max 44ch.
styles.sample: November has brought 0.9 in so far.

styles.name: finding-phone
styles.sample: November has brought 0.9 in so far.

styles.name: condition
styles.usage: The condition sentence beside the temperature (desktop).
styles.sample: Light rain, 3 degrees cooler than an hour ago.

styles.name: condition-phone
styles.sample: Light rain, cooler than an hour ago.

styles.name: standfirst
styles.usage: One line on how to read the chart, in ink-2, max 62ch. Also the tab label size.
styles.sample: The bold line is this storm so far.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: The tile's subject in sentence case, ink-3, above the finding.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Values in a stat strip, over their label (desktop). Tabular digits.

styles.name: stat-phone
styles.usage: Stat on a phone. Tabular digits.

styles.name: source
styles.usage: The folded source line and its body, ink-3.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base reading text and the page default.
styles.sample: Lookout is one station's own record.

styles.name: axis
styles.usage: Axis ticks, ink-3, tabular digits. The 12px floor applies to all chart text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: In-chart labels, keys and chips, ink-2.

styles.name: annotation
styles.usage: The now label, in now, on a 4px halo in the surface colour; also the phone tab label.

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: 4px: gaps between a chevron and its words, ring padding, small stack gaps.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: 8px: kicker to finding, standfirst to chart, in-chip gaps.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: 12px: chart top margin, grid gutter inside strips.

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: 16px: the tile grid gap, folded-line top padding.

tokens.name: s-5
tokens.usage: 24px: the desktop gutter, ribbon top margin, title to tabs.

tokens.name: s-6
tokens.usage: 32px: the split between a stat strip and its chart.

tokens.name: s-7
tokens.usage: 48px: large section breaks.

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: 72px: the largest break; page bottom padding steps.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page gutter on a phone; 24px on the two- and four-column grids.

tokens.name: tile-pad-phone
tokens.usage: Tile padding under 760px.

tokens.name: tile-pad
tokens.usage: Tile padding on the two- and four-column grids.

tokens.name: r-cell
tokens.usage: Almanac and ramp cells, the gap hatch's corners, hatch swatches.

tokens.name: r-ribbon
tokens.usage: The 48-hour ribbon band (0 on a phone, where it runs edge to edge).

tokens.name: r-tab-phone
tokens.usage: A target in the phone bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: r-row
tokens.usage: Event rows.

tokens.name: r-tile-phone
tokens.usage: Tile corners under 760px.

tokens.name: r-tile
tokens.usage: Tile corners on the two- and four-column grids.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Tabs, segments, chips, buttons, the size bar.

hatching.note: The gap hatch: 135 degree stripes in hatch over the surface colour. Text never sits on the stripes.

tokens.name: hatch-stripe
tokens.usage: Stripe weight of the gap hatch (135 degrees).

tokens.name: hatch-repeat
tokens.usage: Stripe repeat of the gap hatch on a surface.

tokens.name: hatch-chip-stripe
tokens.usage: Stripe weight in a 12px hatched chip swatch.

tokens.name: hatch-chip-repeat
tokens.usage: Stripe repeat in a chip swatch.

tokens.name: tab-height
tokens.usage: A desktop section tab pill.

tokens.name: tab-phone-height
tokens.usage: A target in the phone bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: segment-height-phone
tokens.usage: A segment of the 30 / 90 switch on a phone; buttons are 44px minimum.

tokens.name: segment-height
tokens.usage: A segment from 760px.

tokens.name: finding-row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a closed finding row.

tokens.name: fold-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a folded source line.

tokens.name: select-target
tokens.usage: Station selector minimum height.

tokens.name: ribbon-height
tokens.usage: The ribbon band (40 to 46px by design).

tokens.name: ribbon-rain-height
tokens.usage: The ribbon's rain track.

tokens.name: almanac-cell
tokens.usage: Almanac cell height; cells are square and shrink with the column below 680px.

tokens.name: size-bar-height
tokens.usage: The event size bar: a rain-bar pill on a full-width rule track.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every control, in ink.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Focus ring offset; -3px inside a segment.

tokens.name: hatch-swatch
tokens.usage: Side of the hatched chip's swatch.

tokens.name: bp-chart-narrow
tokens.usage: A chart narrower than this draws its phone layout, read from the chart's own width.

tokens.name: bp-two
tokens.usage: Viewport width at which the page goes to two columns, tabs move to the header, and desktop type steps apply.

tokens.name: bp-four
tokens.usage: Viewport width at which the tile grid has four columns.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Widest the page column grows.
